name: design-taste-frontend
title_zh: 先读需求再定调性的前端设计，出手不像模板
tagline_zh: 受够了 AI 生成的落地页一眼就是模板：紫色渐变、居中大标题、三张卡片。它先读你的 brief 判断该走什么调性。
tagline_en: Tired of AI landing pages that scream template: purple gradient, centered hero, three cards. It reads your brief.
desc_en: Anti-slop frontend skill for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns. The agent reads the brief, infers the right design direction, and ships interfaces that do not look templated. Real design systems when applicable, audit-first on redesigns, strict pre-flight check.
why_zh: 把「审美」拆成可执行步骤：先推断方向，再选系统，改版先审计，最后过一遍 pre-flight 检查。
why_en: Turns taste into steps: infer direction, choose a system, audit before redesign, then run a strict pre-flight check.
limit_zh: 它只管前端界面这一格：落地页、作品集、改版。不做后端、不做数据可视化、不做移动端原生。
limit_en: Frontend UI only: landing pages, portfolios, redesigns. No backend, no dataviz, no native mobile. Without a brief or reference sites it guesses, and.
title_en: Frontend design that reads the brief before picking a.
